_comment: Characters are DATA (CLAUDE.md §11). Each has a starter_deck (card ids) and a signature passive. Designed on the 'climbs well <-> hits hard' dependency axis so pairs combo (design/climbing-and-characters.md). Decks now lean into TIMED cards (the double-timing feel the user likes) for interactive climbs/strikes, each with reliable non-timed support cards. Passive types: climb_bonus (+N Height per climb card you play), attack_bonus (+N to your attacks), ally_climb (when YOU climb, your ally also gains N Height), none.

frog.name: The Frog
frog.desc: Nimble — climbs fast and tags the weak point, but hits soft.

vine_weaver.name: The Vine-Weaver
vine_weaver.desc: Grows vines that lift the ally, and poisons the beast so it bleeds.

mountain_climbers.name: The Mountain Climbers
mountain_climbers.desc: Roped — the ally climbs when they do, and they hit harder the higher they are.

goblin_mech.name: The Goblin Engineer
goblin_mech.desc: Heavy hitter — wrecks the weak point, but climbs terribly. Builds timed grapples to haul up.
